why: SwiftUI 原生窗口，不开 HTTP 服务；照片解析交给包内 PyInstaller 打包的 Python 引擎（安装体积主要来自它），以子进程运行、做完即退出。打开期间自动整理一直在跑：内容识别没做完时每批 12 张、隔 0.3 秒接着跑；识别完后每轮结束隔 60 秒再全量重跑一次引擎，不看图库有没有变化，空闲 CPU 主要花在这里。
why_en: Native SwiftUI window with no HTTP server. Photo analysis runs in a bundled Python engine packaged with PyInstaller, which accounts for most of the app's size. The engine runs as a subprocess that exits when done. Auto-organizing keeps running while the app is open: until content recognition is finished, it processes batches of 12 photos back to back with a 0.3-second gap. After that, the engine does a full rebuild 60 seconds after each pass, whether or not the library changed, and that is where most idle CPU goes.
